answer:
Among the occupations ranked in the top‑10 of U.S. News & World Report’s 2025 “100 Best Jobs in America,” only two have a Future Prospects score above 9:

| Rank | Occupation        | Future Prospects | Median Salary (2023‑24) |
|------|-------------------|------------------|-------------------------|
| 1    | Nurse Practitioner | 9.0              | $129,210 |
| 2    | IT Manager         | **9.2**          | **$171,200** |
| 3    | Physician Assistant | 8.9           | $133,260 |
> (The remaining top‑10 jobs have scores below 9.)

**IT Manager** has the highest median salary ($171,200) among those whose Future Prospects score exceeds 9.
